MISSION SCALE

BV
6,000 BVper side

Each Scale point is 2,000 BV. Scale 3 (6,000 BV) is the recommended pick-up game size.

◆Scale 1–2 uses only the first six missions: Ambush through General Melee.
MISSION SELECTION

Who chooses the brief?

Random follows the Standard Mission Table: two 1D6 rolls at Scale 3+, one 1D6 at Scale 1–2.
